ἑαυτοῦ παρουσίας, τῆς γενομέ- νης ἐν τῷδε τῷ κόσμῳ μετὰ σαρκὸς, ὅτι "6Ἐν τῷ
καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ, λέγει Κύριος, διδοὺς νόμους μου εἰς τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν, καὶ εἰς τὰς
καρδίας αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς."6 Ὀρθῶς δὲ καὶ τοῦτο συνεὶς ὁ πάνσοφος Παῦλος
γράφει, καί φησι τοῖς τούτου τετυχηκόσιν· "6Ἡ ἐπιστολὴ ἡ ἡμῶν ὑμεῖς ἐστε, ἐγγε-
γραμμένη οὐ μέλανι, ἀλλὰ πνεύματι Θεοῦ ζῶντος."6 Οὐκοῦν ἀκούσατέ μου, φησὶ,
τοῦτ' ἔστι, τοὺς ἐμοὺς εἰσδέξασθε λόγους, καὶ μὴ καθάπερ ὁ Ἰσραὴλ ἐξ- ήνιοι
γένεσθε, τῇ τοῦ νομικοῦ γράμματος προσκεί- μενοι παλαιότητι, καὶ παρὰ τῶν τύπων
ὁρῶντες οὐδέν. Μέχρι καιροῦ διορθώσεως ἡ διὰ Μωσέως τέθειται ἐντολὴ, φησίν.
Ἐπειδὴ δὲ ὁ τῆς ἐνανθρωπή- σεως οὐ προσδοκᾶται μᾶλλον, ἀλλ' ἐνέστηκεν ἤδη
καιρὸς, μεταχωρείτω πρὸς ἀλήθειαν ἡ σκιά. Ἐμοῦ τοίνυν ἀκούετε, λαός μου. Λέγων
δὲ, λαός μου, τὴν πνευματικὴν οἰκειότητα τὴν δωρηθεῖσαν αὐτοῖς ἐπὶ καιροῦ
προΐσχεται, δυσωπῶν, ὥς γε οἶμαι, καὶ διὰ τούτου, καὶ προθυμοτέρους ἀποτελῶν εἴς
γε τὸ χρῆναι, φημὶ, τὸν παρ' αὐτοῦ προσήκασθαι λόγον. Καλεῖ δὲ οὐχὶ μόνους τοὺς
τελοῦντας ἐν λαοῖς, ἀλλὰ γὰρ σὺν αὐτοῖς καὶ βασιλέας, ἵνα τοὺς ἄρχοντας ἤτοι τοὺς
τῶν λαῶν ἡγουμένους ἐννοῇς. Ἀπὸ γὰρ τῆς τῶν πιστευσάντων πληθύος
παρεκομίσθησαν εἰς τοῦτο πολλοὶ, ὧν ἀπαρχὴ γεγόνασιν οἱ θεσπέσιοι μαθηταί· εἶτα
μετ' ἐκείνους κατ' ἴχνος ἰόντες οἱ μετ' αὐτοὺς τὸ τῆς βασιλείας ὄνομα περιετέθησαν·
ἅτε δὴ καὶ βασιλείας ὄνομα πεπλουτηκότες, τεταγμένοι δὲ καὶ εἰς τὸ καθηγεῖσθαι
λαῶν. Καὶ γοῦν ὡς ἐκ πολλῆς ἄγαν χαρᾶς χαριστηρίους ᾠδὰς ἀνατείνουσι Θεῷ
λέγοντες· "6Ὑπέταξε λαοὺς ἡμῖν, καὶ ἔθνη ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας ἡμῶν."6 Ψάλλει δὲ περὶ
αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ θεσπέ- σιος Μελῳδός· "6Ἄρχοντες λαῶν συνήχθησαν μετὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ
Ἀβραάμ."6 Ὦ τοίνυν λαοὶ καὶ βασιλεῖς, 70.1112 φησὶν, ἀκούσατέ μου, καὶ
ἐνωτίσασθε, καὶ τί τὸ μέλλον ἐπαγγέλ[λ]εσθε. Νόμος παρ' ἐμοῦ ἐξελεύσεται, καὶ ἡ
κρίσις μου εἰς φῶς ἐθνῶν. Νόμον ἐν τούτοις τὸ θεῖόν τε καὶ εὐαγγελικὸν ὀνομάζει
κήρυγμα. Καὶ γάρ ἐστιν ἑτεροειδὲς μὲν ὥσπερ τὸ θέσπισμα τὸ νέον τε καὶ σωτήριον·
νόμου δὲ ὥσπερ ἀρχαίου μεταβολὴ πρὸς τὸ ἄμεινον, καὶ μετάστασις τύπων
ἐκδεδραμη- κότων πρὸς ἀλήθειαν. Ἔφη γοῦν ὁ Χριστός· "6Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον
καταλῦσαι τὸν νόμον ἢ τοὺς προ- φήτας· οὐκ ἦλθον καταλῦσαι, ἀλλὰ πληρῶσαι. 409 Λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἰῶτα ἓν ἢ μία κεραία οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου, ἕως ἂν
πάντα γένηται."6 Ἀλλ' ὁ μὲν ἐν γράμμασι νόμος ἐδόθη διὰ Μωσέως· κήρυγμα δὲ τὸ
σωτήριον, τοῦτ' ἔστι τὸ εὐαγγελικὸν, ἐξῆλθε διὰ Χριστοῦ. Καὶ γὰρ ἦν ἀκόλουθον,
Μωσέα μὲν τῆς σκιᾶς καὶ τύπου γενέσθαι διάκονον, ὡς ἔοικε, γνώ- σεώς τε καὶ
ἀληθοῦς λατρείας
pass_a_gloss: [...] about his own coming, the one that came to be in this world with flesh, that: In that time, says the Lord, giving my laws into their mind, and upon their hearts I will write them. And the all-wise Paul, having rightly understood this too, writes, and says to those who had obtained this: Our letter you are, written in not with ink, but with Spirit of living God. So hear me, he says, that is, receive my words, and do not become unruly like Israel, devoted to the oldness of the letter of the Law, and seeing nothing beside the types. Until a time of correction the commandment through Moses has been laid down, he says. But since the time of the becoming man is no longer awaited, but is already present, let the shadow move over toward truth. Hear me then, my people. And saying, my people, he holds forth the spiritual kinship given to them at the right time, shaming them, as I think, through this too, and making them more eager toward the need, I say, to admit the word from him. And he calls not only those counted among peoples, but indeed with them also kings, so that you may understand the rulers, or the leaders of the peoples. For from the multitude of those who believed many were brought forward into this, of whom the divine disciples became firstfruits; then after those, those after them going in the track were clothed with the name of the kingship; inasmuch as having been enriched with the name of kingship, and appointed also to lead peoples. And so as from very much joy they raise thank-offering songs to God, saying: He subjected peoples to us, and nations under our feet. And the divine Melodist sings about them too: Rulers of peoples were gathered with the God of Abraham. O then peoples and kings, he says, hear me, and give ear, and what the future is, be told. A law will go out from me, and my judgment for a light of nations. A law in these he names the divine and gospel proclamation. For indeed the new and saving decree is as it were of another kind; but it is as it were a change of an ancient law toward the better, and a removal of types that have run out toward truth. And so Christ said: Do not think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets; I did not come to destroy, but to fulfil. For I say to you that one iota or one stroke will surely not pass from the law until all things come to be. But the law in letters was given through Moses; and the saving proclamation, that is, the gospel one, went out through Christ. And indeed it was consistent that Moses become minister of the shadow and type, as it seems, of knowledge and true worship [the section breaks off].
pass_b_english: … concerning his own coming, which took place in this world with flesh: “In that time, says the Lord, I will put my laws into their mind, and I will write them on their hearts” (Jeremiah 31:33; Hebrews 8:10). The all-wise Paul rightly understood this too, and writes, saying to those who had received it, “You are our letter, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God” (2 Corinthians 3:2-3).

So, “Hear me,” he says, that is, receive my words, and do not become unruly as Israel did, clinging to the oldness of the letter of the Law and seeing nothing beyond the types. The commandment given through Moses was laid down “until the time of reformation,” he says (Hebrews 9:10). But since the time of the incarnation is no longer awaited, but is already here, let the shadow give way to the truth.

“Hear me, then, my people” (Isaiah 51:4). In saying “my people,” he holds out to them the spiritual kinship granted to them in due time. By this too, I think, he puts them to shame, and makes them more eager to accept the word that comes from him.

He calls not only those who belong among the peoples, but kings along with them, so that you may understand the rulers, that is, the leaders of the peoples. For many were brought to this rank from the multitude of believers, and the divine disciples were their firstfruits. Then those who followed after them in their footsteps were given the name of kingship, since they were rich in the name of kingship and were also appointed to lead the peoples.

And so, as if from very great joy, they lift up songs of thanksgiving to God, saying, “He subjected peoples to us, and nations under our feet” (Psalm 47:3). The divine Psalmist also sings of them: “The rulers of the peoples were gathered together with the God of Abraham” (Psalm 47:9).
“O peoples and kings,” he says, “hear me and give ear,” and learn what is promised for the time to come. “A law will go out from me, and my judgment for a light of the nations” (Isaiah 51:4).

Here he calls the divine Gospel proclamation a law. For the new and saving decree is of another kind, as it were; yet it is, as it were, a change of the old law for the better, and a passing over of the types, which have run their course, into the truth. So Christ said, “Do not think that I came to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I did not come to abolish but to fulfill. For I tell you, not one iota or one stroke will pass from the Law until all things take place” (Matthew 5:17-18).

But the law in letters was given through Moses, while the saving proclamation, that is, the Gospel, went out through Christ (compare John 1:17). For it was fitting that Moses should become the minister of the shadow and the type, as it seems, of knowledge and of true worship …

choices.english: “Hear me,” he says, that is, receive my words
choices.why: A call to receive the word, not a command to 'receive the spiritual affinity'.
The title 'my people' shames them and makes them eager.
ἐξήνιος, throwing off the reins; not 'hardened'.
The Gospel is a new kind of law, yet the old law changed for the better.
The types have run their race and pass into truth.
